verdict_html: Not enough settled Reels yet to say anything. Lessons appear here once at least three Reels are 48 hours old.
notes: Small sample. {{n_videos}} Reels with {{views_range}} views each. Curves move while a Reel is young, so treat anything under 48 hours old as provisional.

Where the numbers come from. Retention is Instagram's own per-second Reel insights curve (the one the phone app shows), read from your signed-in session in its own cmux browser profile. The app rounds down, so the page can read up to a point higher than the phone. Transcripts are local Whisper with word timestamps. Visual notes are one Gemini watch pass per Reel when a Gemini key is set; the first frames shown are real frames.

Measured vs explained. Numbers with a second next to them are measured. Anything marked possible explanation is a hypothesis: a drop that lines up with a sentence does not prove the sentence caused it.
Refresh it. Run /retention-teardown-instagram in Claude Code, inside cmux.
